description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class within the Aws\Glacier namespace, responsible for managing multipart uploads to Amazon Glacier. It includes methods for creating, resuming, and handling multipart upload workflows, including chunking data, hashing, and interacting with the Glacier service.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart upload operations to Amazon Glacier, including initiating uploads, uploading parts, and finalizing the archive. Supports resuming uploads, configurable part sizes, and hashing for data integrity.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Fetches and constructs the upload state from Glacier by listing parts already uploaded, supporting upload resumption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MultipartUploader with configuration options such as source data, upload parameters, and callbacks.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Provides the configuration for the upload workflow, such as command names and identifiers.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Validates and retrieves the part size for upload; ensures it matches allowed sizes.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Reads a segment of data from the source, creates a part with hashing for integrity, or returns false if no data.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes the result of an upload part, updating the upload state.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for initiating a multipart upload, including part size and optional archive description.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Calculates the total archive size and checksum for completing the upload.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with hashing streams to compute linear and tree hashes.

methods.name: parseRange
methods.description: Parses a Glacier range string into a part index and size.
